attr.title: ZQuest Classic
attr.desc: ZQuest Classic (formerly Zelda Classic) is an open source engine for top-down Zelda-style adventure games, with a library of hundreds of fan-made quests. This port includes the player plus the bundled demo quest The Deep; more quests, including the original classic quests, can be downloaded from PureZC.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box. To add quests, drop quest .zip files from purezc.net into the zquestclassic/quests folder.
